summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing of USD 1.25 billion 4.983% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Notes due 2032. The notes are a plain-vanilla debt issuance with proceeds allocated to general banking business, closing on June 18, 2026. This is an ordinary debt offering, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report for a foreign private issuer; no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation category applies. There is no event risk or arbitrage angle.
